## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Tech — NVDA, META, ORCL, INTC + DE).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy lead: CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND.  
Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND.  
Financials steady: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Communication weak: GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND.  
Materials/Industrials soft: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5 SP100 movers: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Tech-heavy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -7.08% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Communication names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: DE (1W: +10.03%), INTC (1W: +7.07%), META (1W: +6.70%), NVDA (1W: +5.89%), ORCL (1W: +5.26%). Watch INTC (RECOVERY) for follow-through and PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION as a divergence between 1W weakness and 1M strength.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed to rotational: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND are leaders, while MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND show dispersion; sector 1W: -0.70%.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Internal rotation: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND and selective banks showing resilience, but card stocks V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%) CORRECTION signal uneven breadth; sector 1W: +0.43%.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Cautious stability: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND offset LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: +0.15%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Energy and select Financials and top Tech winners (NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to isolated weak names showing confirmed BELOW TREND (GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow top-5 concentration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76%, 10 stocks) and Utilities (1W: +2.10%, 10 stocks) on leadership and stock-level strength.  
BEARISH: Communication (1W: -2.13%, 10 stocks) and Industrials (1W: -1.76%, 15 stocks) given notable weekly weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA continuation: hold 1W momentum and remain ABOVE TREND for broad risk confirmation. AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for pullback to test 1M trend. PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND — watch for additional downside on volume as a sign of sustained breakdown.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
PLTR (+75): headline shows upgraded fair value after strong Q2; PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION — bullish news but 1W weakness = divergence to watch.  
AMZN (+55): AWS GPU buildout cited; AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND — positive catalyst but price not confirming.  
DE / D context: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND has strong price confirmation of bullish flow.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
GOOGL (-45): headlines on rising power costs; GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
TTWO (-50): negative franchise/leak headlines; TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND — confirmed downside.  
COST headline negative (-45) flagged in feed but COST not in core detailed list; focus on company-specific catalysts where price confirms.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Top-5 concentration in Tech. NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: leadership narrowness and several bullish headlines (PLTR, AMZN) diverging from 1W price action — monitor for trend breaks.
